name: FEFO consumes the earliest-expiring grants across lots
input: two simultaneously active grants and one charge spanning both
test:
ledger = GPUCreditLedger()
ledger.add_credit('early', 4, 0, 5)
ledger.add_credit('later', 10, 0, 20)
ledger.charge(5, 1)
assert ledger.get_balance(1) == 9
assert ledger.get_balance(4) == 9
assert ledger.get_balance(5) == 9

name: out-of-order arrival is replayed in event-time order
input: charge arrives before a grant that started before it
test:
ledger = GPUCreditLedger()
ledger.charge(4, 10)
ledger.add_credit('late-arrival', 5, 0, 20)
ledger.add_credit('future', 100, 11, 30)
assert ledger.get_balance(10) == 1
assert ledger.get_balance(11) == 101
assert ledger.get_balance(10) == 1

name: same-timestamp grants precede charges and expiration is exclusive
input: a grant and charge at 10, then a charge at its expiry
test:
ledger = GPUCreditLedger()
ledger.charge(3, 10)
ledger.add_credit('same-time', 3, 10, 12)
assert ledger.get_balance(10) == 0
ledger.add_credit('expires-now', 2, 0, 12)
ledger.charge(1, 12)
assert ledger.get_balance(12) is None

name: failed replay is atomic and a valid backdated grant can repair it
input: a charge larger than available credit, followed by a backdated repair
test:
ledger = GPUCreditLedger()
ledger.add_credit('first', 3, 0, 30)
ledger.charge(5, 10)
assert ledger.get_balance(20) is None
ledger.add_credit('repair', 2, 0, 30)
assert ledger.get_balance(20) == 0

name: queries are isolated, fractional amounts and timestamps are valid, and malformed calls fail
input: a past query after a future query, fractional credit, charge, and timestamps, plus malformed calls
test:
ledger = GPUCreditLedger()
ledger.add_credit('credit', 5, 0, 10)
assert ledger.get_balance(20) == 0
assert ledger.get_balance(5) == 5
ledger.add_credit('fractional', 2.5, 0.5, 10.5)
ledger.charge(0.75, 5.5)
assert ledger.get_balance(5.5) == 6.75
bad_calls = [
    lambda: ledger.add_credit('credit', 1, 0, 1),
    lambda: ledger.add_credit('', 1, 0, 1),
    lambda: ledger.add_credit('zero', 0, 0, 1),
    lambda: ledger.add_credit('backwards', 1, 2, 2),
    lambda: ledger.charge(0, 1),
]
for call in bad_calls:
    try:
        call()
        assert False, 'expected ValueError'
    except ValueError:
        pass
